name: California Cobb Salad with Dijon Vinaigrette

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
Heat a skillet over medium-low heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut bacon strips in half crosswise.

Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken and bacon. Cook chicken until golden brown and no longer pink inside, 4-5 minutes per side. Cook bacon until crispy, 4-5 minutes per side. Transfer both to a plate lined with paper towels.
Peel and mince garlic. In a medium bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together the garlic, olive oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
9 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
3 tsp Dijon mustard
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash lettuce, halve lengthwise, then chop crosswise into 2 ½ cm strips.
Halve and pit avocados; scoop out the flesh and medium dice.
Cut chicken into cubes. Roughly chop bacon. Peel and roughly chop eggs.
To serve, arrange a bed of lettuce on a plate, then add tomatoes, avocado, chicken, bacon, eggs, and blue cheese in rows over top. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled blue cheese
